messages.author: a5e1111eb2b1e4c4
messages.subject: [IRACE-Test instances] Is it possible to run the testing automatically just after the ending of IRACE tuning in training instances?
parts:
Hi All,

In "The irace Package: User Guide" (August, 2017), I can't find any answer for the question above. On page 26, there is an instruction that shows how to start the testing with the test instances (specified by the options "testInstancesDir" and "testInstancesFile") using the command "testing.main(logFile = "./irace.Rdata")". It works perfectly. However, I should wait for the tuning to be finished and write the command on the R prompt (console).

If there is any way to run the testing automatically just after the ending of IRACE tuning in training instances, please let me know.

Best wishes,

André de Souza

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: [IRACE-Test instances] Is it possible to run the testing automatically just after the ending of IRACE tuning in training instances?
parts:
Dear Andre,

Absolutely. If you provide test instances in the scenario.txt file, then irace will automatically run the best configurations found on them after tuning. You can control which configurations are run with testNbElites and testIterationElites (Section 7).

Cheers,

Manuel.

parts:
Hi Manuel,

Thanks for the answer.

So, I think something got wrong! I cannot find the R object "iraceResults$testing" after load the log file defined in "iraceResults$scenario$logFile" (command "load("irace.Rdata")").

Moreover, there's no *-t.stdout files (my program's output file whose name is set by IRACE through the .bat file) in the work directory (yes, there's so many *.stdout files created in the tuning phase, mas no *-t.stdout).

My scenario,txt is okay. I defined settings for "testInstancesFile", "testInstancesDir", "testNbElites" and "testIterationElites". As a demonstration it's prettty right, when I run the command "testing.main(logFile = "./irace.Rdata")", everything is all right: I have both "iraceResults$testing" R object and "*t.stdout" files.

But no problem! I have overcame that (automatic run of test phase) by writing a script in R that calls "testing.main(logFile = "./irace.Rdata")" and run it just after the tuning phase has finished.

Thank you so much! 

Best wishes,

André

P.S.: I have another issue, but that's another topic. About to open it... ;-)

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: [irace-package] Re: [IRACE-Test instances] Is it possible to run the testing automatically just after the ending of IRACE tuning in training instances?
parts:
It seems you (or your irace.bat) are calling the R function irace() directly, instead of using irace.main() or irace.cmdline(), like the wrappers we provide do. The function irace() does not do testing, however, the higher-level wrappers irace.main() and irace.cmdline() do.

For example, in inst/bin/irace.bat:

@echo off
:: Windows has problems with spaces in directory names. Thus, it is better to
:: install R somewhere like "C:\R". You also need to add both R and the
:: directory where irace.bat is located to the PATH.
:: To edit the PATH in Windows, search for "Environment variables" in the
:: control panel, then edit PATH, then
:: add a string similar to "C:\R_PATH\bin;C:\IRACE_HOME\bin", where R_PATH
:: should be R's installation path and IRACE_HOME is irace's installation path
:: (the output given by running 'system.file(package="irace")' within R).
R.exe --vanilla --slave -e "library(irace);irace.cmdline()" --args %*


Cheers,

Manuel.

messages.author: a5e1111eb2b1e4c4

parts:
Hi Manuel,

You are right. I did what has been taught on page 9 ("The irace Package: User Guide"; August, 2017) and I called "irace(scenario = scenario, parameters = parameters)" directly.

But after your explanation, I used "irace.main(scenario = scenario)" and IRACE run the tests automatically, just after the end of tuning on training instances.

Thank you so much.

Best wishes,

André
